title: SLASH · The bay at low tide
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: The bay at low tide with the riverboat gone and a rectangle in the mud the size of a boat, water standing in it, gulls at its edge. The framer on the flats with the dog — the novel has a dog after all; it's drawn in from the strip — looking at where a thing was. The page the canon will draw a hundred ways is drawn here first, as a crime scene.

panels.composition: Full page: wide mudflats at low tide with a huge rectangle of standing water where a boat's hull rested, gulls at its edge, a man in a coat and a small dog small at the rectangle's corner, rain hatching starting at the top of the page.
